question: Should the Convex AI-file automation be changed to preserve OpenClaw-compatible single-line skill frontmatter before this generated refresh is allowed to merge?
rationale: The generated output conflicts with the documented loader contract, and a one-off manual edit may make the generator's status check permanently disagree with the repository.

options.title: Preserve loader compatibility
options.body: Update or post-process the generator so skill descriptions remain single-line, rerun from current main, and validate skill discovery.

options.title: Make these skills Codex-only
options.body: Accept the generated multiline format only after explicitly removing or documenting OpenClaw project-agent compatibility for these repository skills.

recommendation.title: Preserve loader compatibility
recommendation.body: Update or post-process the generator so skill descriptions remain single-line, rerun from current main, and validate skill discovery.

likelyOwner.reason: This requires a human repository-level choice about the generated-file contract and compatibility boundary.
